name: Daywise Customer Details
query:
SELECT
    b.posting_date AS "Posting Date:Date:120",
    b.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:150",
    b.mobile_number AS "Customer Mobile:Data:120",
    COUNT(b.name) AS "Invoice Count:Int:100",
    SUM(b.grand_total) AS "Total Purchase Amount:Currency:120",
    SUM(b.outstanding_amount) AS "Outstanding Amount:Currency:120"
FROM 
    `tabPOS Invoice` b
WHERE
    b.docstatus = 1
    AND b.posting_date BETWEEN %(start_date)s AND %(end_date)s
    AND (%(pos_profile)s IS NULL OR b.pos_profile = %(pos_profile)s)
GROUP BY
    b.posting_date, b.customer
ORDER BY
    b.posting_date DESC, b.customer_name ASC
